Local runtime files for offline startup:
- fabric-5.3.1.min.js: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/fabric.js/5.3.1/fabric.min.js (MIT, license notice in file).
  Kept at the version previously loaded by index.html to preserve the drawing API.
- pdfmake.min.js and vfs_fonts.js: copied from installed pdfmake 0.2.18 (MIT; LICENSE-pdfmake).
All files are cached with the application build. Update deliberately alongside PDF/drawing verification.
